ProcessPage.title: Our Process
ProcessPage.subtitle: A structured approach to delivering quality solutions
ProcessPage.intro: We follow a proven 6-step process designed to deliver exceptional results while keeping you informed and involved every step of the way. From initial discovery to ongoing support, our methodology ensures your project succeeds.
ProcessPage.step01Desc: We begin by understanding your business, goals, and requirements. Through consultations and research, we identify challenges, opportunities, and the best path forward for your project.
ProcessPage.step02Desc: Our design team creates wireframes, prototypes, and visual designs that align with your brand and user needs. We iterate based on your feedback until the design is perfect.
ProcessPage.step03Desc: With approved designs, our developers build your solution using modern technologies and best practices. We follow agile methodologies, providing regular updates and demos throughout development.
ProcessPage.step04Desc: Our QA team thoroughly tests your solution across different devices, browsers, and scenarios. We ensure everything works as expected and meets quality standards before launch.
ProcessPage.step05Desc: We handle the deployment process, ensuring smooth launch with minimal downtime. This includes server configuration, domain setup, SSL certificates, and initial go-live support.
ProcessPage.step06Desc: After launch, we provide ongoing support including bug fixes, updates, monitoring, and enhancements. We're here to ensure your solution continues to serve your business effectively.
ProcessPage.whyClearCommBody: Regular updates and demos ensure you're always informed about progress and can provide feedback when it matters most.
ProcessPage.whyAgileBody: Our process adapts to your needs. We can adjust timelines, priorities, and approaches based on changing requirements.
ProcessPage.whyQualityBody: Built-in quality checks at every stage ensure we deliver solutions that meet your standards and exceed expectations.
ProcessPage.whyPartnershipBody: Our process extends beyond launch with ongoing support, ensuring your solution evolves with your business needs.

FAQPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQPage.subtitle: Common questions about our services, pricing, and processes
FAQPage.ctaBody: We're here to help. Get in touch and we'll answer any questions you have.
FAQPage.q01: How much does a website cost?
FAQPage.a01: Website costs vary depending on complexity, features, and requirements. Basic websites typically start around $500-$1,500, while custom web applications can range from $2,000 to $10,000 or more. We provide detailed quotes after understanding your specific needs.
FAQPage.q02: How long does it take to build a website?
FAQPage.a02: Simple websites typically take 2-4 weeks, while more complex projects can take 6-12 weeks. Timeline depends on project scope, design complexity, and client feedback cycles. We provide detailed timelines during the discovery phase.
FAQPage.a03: Yes, we provide reliable cloud hosting and domain services with 99.9% uptime guarantee. Our hosting solutions are optimized for African markets with local support and competitive pricing.
FAQPage.q04: What payment methods do you accept?
FAQPage.a04: We accept bank transfers, mobile money (MTN, Airtel, M-Pesa), and international payment methods. Payment terms are flexible and discussed during project planning.
FAQPage.q05: Do you provide ongoing maintenance and support?
FAQPage.a05: Yes, we offer various support packages from basic maintenance to comprehensive managed services. Ongoing support includes updates, security patches, backups, and technical assistance.
FAQPage.q06: Can you integrate mobile money payments?
FAQPage.a06: Absolutely. We specialize in integrating local payment methods including MTN Mobile Money, Airtel Money, M-Pesa, and other regional payment gateways. This is essential for e-commerce and donation platforms in East Africa.
FAQPage.q07: What is included in your ERP system?
FAQPage.a07: Our ERP systems typically include inventory management, sales, finance, HR, and production modules. We customize the solution to match your specific business processes and requirements.
FAQPage.q08: How long does ERP implementation take?
FAQPage.a08: ERP implementation typically takes 8-16 weeks depending on complexity and customization needs. This includes discovery, design, development, data migration, testing, training, and deployment phases.
FAQPage.q09: Do you provide training for ERP systems?
FAQPage.a09: Yes, comprehensive training is included with all ERP implementations. We train your team on system usage, workflows, and reporting. Ongoing training support is available as needed.
FAQPage.q10: Can you develop mobile apps for both iOS and Android?
FAQPage.a10: Yes, we develop both native iOS and Android applications, as well as cross-platform solutions using React Native or Flutter. We help you choose the best approach based on your requirements and budget.
FAQPage.q11: How long does mobile app development take?
FAQPage.a11: Simple mobile apps take 6-10 weeks, while more complex applications can take 12-20 weeks. Timeline includes design, development, testing, and app store submission.
FAQPage.q12: What is the cost of mobile app development?
FAQPage.a12: Mobile app costs range from $3,000 for simple apps to $15,000+ for complex applications. Factors include features, platform (iOS, Android, or both), design complexity, and integrations.
FAQPage.q13: Do you handle app store submission?
FAQPage.a13: Yes, we handle the entire app store submission process for both iOS App Store and Google Play Store, including preparing required materials and managing the approval process.
FAQPage.q14: What hosting speed can I expect?
FAQPage.a14: Our hosting infrastructure is optimized for speed with CDN integration and modern technologies. Typical load times are under 2 seconds, though actual speeds depend on your website's optimization and user's internet connection.
FAQPage.a15: We use cloud infrastructure with servers in multiple locations, including options in Africa where available. This reduces latency and improves performance for users in East Africa.
FAQPage.q16: Can you help migrate my existing website?
FAQPage.a16: Yes, we provide website migration services including content transfer, data migration, DNS configuration, and testing. We ensure minimal downtime during the migration process.
FAQPage.q17: Do you offer website redesign services?
FAQPage.a17: Yes, we offer complete website redesigns to modernize existing sites, improve user experience, and enhance functionality. We can work with your existing content or create new content as needed.
FAQPage.a18: We use modern web technologies including Next.js, React, Node.js, and cloud platforms. For mobile apps, we use React Native, Flutter, and native development. We choose technologies that best fit each project's needs.
FAQPage.q19: Do you work with NGOs and nonprofits?
FAQPage.a19: Yes, we have extensive experience working with NGOs and nonprofits across East Africa. We offer special pricing and understand the unique needs of mission-driven organizations.
FAQPage.q20: What is your typical response time for support?
FAQPage.a20: Response times vary by support package. Priority support responds within 2-4 hours, standard support within 24 hours, and basic support within 48 hours. Emergency issues are addressed immediately.
